title: Rethinking Toxicity Evaluation in Large Language Model: A Multi-Label Perspective
reasoning: The paper benchmarks toxicity in LLMs across 15 fine-grained categories related to safety and harm (e.g., hate speech, harassment, sexual content), which involves evaluating the moral and ethical alignment of AI-generated content. It also includes a formal Ethics and Moral Statement regarding the human annotation process and the broader impacts of safety evaluation.
